The '''Eddelian-Empire War''' was fought between the [[Eddel]]ians of the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The anti-[[Alien/Legends|alien]] Empire decimated the Eddel [[Species/Legends|species]], reducing their number to a few thousand, and eliminating most of their technology in the process.<ref name="SWGK" />
